subject: Re: Reliability trend: remediation options & renewal pathway
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Incident trend affecting renewal — request for remediation & options

Jordan —

Thanks for taking this — over the past six weeks we’ve seen three distinct windows where our production traffic experienced elevated tail latency and two brief regional outages. I’ve attached a short summary (incident-log-summary.pdf) for your SREs.

We’re approaching our annual renewal (mid-May) and the execs are pushing back: they want a concrete reliability remediation plan, some commercial remediation for customer impact, and clarity on what an upgraded SLA/premium tier actually guarantees.

Concretely we’d like to discuss:
- A defined SLA amendment (SLOs, credits, measurement window)
- A credit for the March / April incidents (our estimate = 20% of April invoice unless otherwise justified)
- A time-boxed premium trial (3 months) so we can evaluate the higher tier before committing

Can you get me a proposal this week? If needed I can loop in procurement (procurement@clearpathhealth.com). Appreciate a short call to align.

— Elena
Elena Torres
VP Engineering, Clearpath Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident trend affecting renewal — request for remediation & options

Elena —

Thanks for the detailed note and for the PDF — I pulled this into our incident tracker. I’m assigning our account SRE (Monica) and sales lead (Ben) to build a remediation + commercial proposal.

Short answers up front:
- We can produce a targeted SLA amendment that spells out measurement and credit triggers.
- We don’t want to slow your renewal timeline — we can offer a one-time commercial credit while we complete a short premium trial.
- We’d like to propose a 3-month premium trial with 99.95% regional availability SLO and a dedicated incident response window (SRE on-call) during the trial.

Availability for a call: Fri 4/2 10:00–11:00 PT or Mon 4/5 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works best?

For context I’m attaching a short support extraction (incident-log-summary.pdf) and will follow up internally with proposed terms.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Internal — Clearpath remediation/commercial approach

Team —

Quick internal read: we should be structured and conservative on the credit ask. Elena asked for 20% of April invoice; reasonable negotiating position but I’d prefer we lead with a 10–15% one-time credit and trade up the trial terms. Proposed package:

- 15% one-time invoice credit for documented incidents in March/April (applied at renewal)
- 3-month premium trial (no additional charge) with standard premium SLA (99.95% p50/p99 latency commitments documented in amendment)
- An opt-in dedicated pilot pool for their highest priority routes during the trial (to demonstrate latency improvements)
- A 1-week observable proof-of-concept (PoC) during which we'll demonstrate p50 and p99 improvements and provide a runbook (support-runbook.txt)

If Marissa signs off on the commercial credit I’ll prep a short amendment and a DocuSign envelope. Thoughts?

Ben
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@clearpathhealth.com>, Clearpath Health Procurement <procurement@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:44:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: remediation credit + 3-month premium trial (draft amendment attached)

Elena —

Per our call today, attached is a draft amendment (amendment_CPH_2027-04.pdf) that captures the terms we discussed. High level:

- One-time commercial credit: 15% of the April 2027 invoice applied at renewal.
- Premium trial: 3 months of premium service (no additional charge) starting on acceptance. Premium includes regional availability SLO = 99.95% measured monthly and enhanced latency routing for pinned routes.
- Proof-of-concept: 1-week PoC during the first month to validate p50 <= 200ms and p99 improvement targets. We’ll provide an on-call SRE and weekly visible telemetry.
- Measurement: Credits are computed against Clearpath’s monthly invoice relative to documented incident windows (as described in the amendment).

Next steps: if procurement is happy, sign the amendment via DocuSign (link below) and we’ll schedule the pilot kickoff the following week. If you prefer, I can reduce the credit sightly in exchange for increasing the trial to 4 months — open to structure.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/CPH/amendment-CP-4872
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/clearp-CP-4872

Attachments: amendment_CPH_2027-04.pdf

Thanks — we want to get you a reliable path forward.

— Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0143

From: Elena Torres <elena@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Clearpath Health Procurement <procurement@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: remediation credit + 3-month premium trial (draft amendment attached)

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear terms. Procurement asks we get two items clarified before signing:
1) Guarantee that during PoC the p50 target is <= 200ms for the three pinned routes; if not met, the trial will be extended by an additional 2 weeks at no charge.
2) A playbook entry that lists exact escalation contacts and SLA measurement queries (this helps our internal audits).

If you can confirm both items in the amendment, procurement will route the DocuSign. We are aligned on the 15% credit as a starting point.

We’d like the pilot kickoff 4/18 if that’s feasible.

— Elena
VP Engineering, Clearpath Health
